label: Natural priority support and the simple priority transport
summary: Read materialized Aquinas In V Metaph. lect.13 nn.15–18 with the full lecture and Aristotle Categories12 in the Edghill translation. Existing n.15 supports a sufficient natural-priority criterion. A precise proposed composition uses that source statement plus a separate natural-priority-to-simple-priority bridge. Categories12 distinguishes nonreciprocal implication from causal priority compatible with reciprocal implication; its truth/fact example is not a two-concrete-bearer counterexample to the exact target. Provisional assessment retains the natural criterion as well motivated while leaving its act/potency application explicit. Neither source makes every explanatory priority modally separable. Preserve direct acceptance, the independent explanatory route and the same domain, respect and modality. See docs/notes/priority-independence-logic-support-investigation.md, section 3. No source claim or graph edge added.
